title: Logarithm of the standard Gaussian density
statement: For every real number $x$, the standard Gaussian density $\varphi(x)$ satisfies $\displaystyle\log\varphi(x)=-\log\sqrt{2\pi}-\frac{x^2}{2}$.
replaced:
Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ be the standard Gaussian density. For every $x\in\mathbb R$, its natural logarithm satisfies
\[
\log\varphi(x)=-\log\sqrt{2\pi}-\frac{x^2}{2}.
\]
